patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts often feature large, full-bleed architectural photography on one side and concise text blocks or structured lists on the other, creating a balanced yet dynamic visual flow.
A single sans-serif typeface is used consistently, with large, bold headings contrasting with lighter-weight body text and uppercase labels, establishing a clear and elegant typographic hierarchy.

The palette relies heavily on a sophisticated blend of muted greys, off-whites, and deep earthy browns/blacks, with a very subtle, almost imperceptible, cool blue used sparingly for interactive elements like links and form buttons.

Content sections and individual elements (text blocks, images) reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scroll. The hero image features a gentle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
Information is frequently presented in framed, minimalist boxes or structured lists with thin horizontal dividers, providing a clean and organized way to digest details without visual clutter.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations to reveal content. As the user scrolls, sections and individual content blocks (text, images) animate into view with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation. The hero image features a gentle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content. The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport and subtly changes its background from transparent to a solid, light color after the initial scroll.

Content is structured in a clean, grid-based layout, often using a two-column approach for text and imagery, or a multi-column card-like display for features. Full-bleed background images are used to establish a sense of place and scale.

A single sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with variations in weight and size to establish a clear typographic hierarchy. Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, and some labels are set in uppercase for emphasis.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly 0px, with crisp edges on all elements like images, buttons, and form fields).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous padding around sections and elements, particularly in the hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness).

standout: The distinctive use of large-scale, architectural photography as full-bleed backgrounds and hero imagery, combined with a minimalist, airy layout and subtle, elegant typography, creates a sophisticated and aspirational brand presence. The design effectively uses negative space and crisp lines to highlight the modular homes themselves, conveying a sense of luxury and precision.
